text:
Hannah: pet photo hour! meet Tofu, our office-to-be hedgehog. refuses to be serious but will pose for snacks. pic: https://i.imgur.com/tofu_spikes.jpg :hedgehog:
Omar: hedgehog!!! instant mood boost. also, is that a tiny scarf? :heart_eyes:
Yuki: Tofu is a fashion icon. also hi from my parrot Mango who insists on repeating 'meeting at 3' on loop. audio: https://files.internal/mango-squawk.mp3 :parrot:
Ben: Mango is already more punctual than me. will he accept coffee? (jokes)
Tess: dog tax: attaching a pic of my rescue, Pita, mid-snooze on a pile of review docs. pic: https://i.imgur.com/pita_snooze.jpg :dog2:
Hannah: love the paperwork sacrifice :joy: also Tofu is bribable with mealworms and tiny hats
HRBot: reminder: please submit the Office Pet Consent form and vaccination docs before bringing animals on site: https://hr.internal/pet-waiver :page_with_curl:
Omar: quick poll: who wants a mixed pet day (hedgehog + parrot + one dog) on Wednesday? React :white_check_mark: for yes, :x: for no
Yuki: yes! Mango will bring motivational squawks. and maybe learn to cheer for deployments :party_popper:
Ben: yes but Mango must not repeat passwords aloud pls :grimacing:
Tess: yes, Pita will supervise naps only. also will bring extra chewy toys
Hannah: also caption contest: "When you realize the sprint demo was actually a nap demo" winner gets to pick everyone's nickname for a day :trophy:
Omar: "I have reviewed your slides and I approve this nap" my vote
Yuki: "Mango demands more snacks" runner-up
Hannah: this thread made my Monday. thanks all, bringing tiny hats and a spare blanket for Tofu :blob_hearts:
